name: prestashopheaven/runtime-shared-kernel
description: Value objects every PrestaHaven module shares, in pure PHP without PrestaShop: the shop constraint (one shop, a shop group or all shops). The only package the Domain layer of a module may use (PKG-09).

prestashopheaven.use-when: A command, query or domain object says which shops it is about (one shop, a shop group, all shops), or the Domain layer needs a shared value object without depending on PrestaShop.
